[center]﻿[/center][center][img]https://files.catbox.moe/b1fb7l.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][font=Georgia][size=5]
Welcome to Logo's Rug Emporium, where you will find the latest in fashionable designs and palettes, all for the discerning decorator in mind. It's been a little while, but we had to renegotiate our designer's contract, and then the supply chain went wonky, and then we had to find a new warehouse because the previous one was too small, and well, it was a bit of a kerfuffle.
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=5]But now we're back with a brand new selection of additional geometric rug designs, all available through Alternative Textures! 15 new designs in both large and small sizes.[/size][/font] 


[center][img]https://files.catbox.moe/7a7fhz.png[/img]﻿[/center][font=Georgia][size=5]
Download this mod and Alternative Textures. Plop into your /Mods folder.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=5]Using these retextures is as easy as snapping your fingers:
[list=1]
[*]For the large designs, get thyself a Blossom Rug.

[*]For the square design, acquire a Funky Rug or a Modern Rug.

[*]For the smaller designs, select from several base rug variations like the Cottage Rug and the Red Rug.

[*][font=Georgia][size=5]Equip your trusty paint bucket[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]5. Swap textures![/size][/font]

(Also compatible with Happy Home Designer)[/list][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][b][u]SPECIAL REQUESTS:[/u][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4]See a rug design you love but would like in a different color? Drop a special order request in the Comments section and we will consider it for the next version of this showcase! (Fine Print: All requests will be contemplated and voted on by the Logo's Rug Emporium Leadership Team. In no way do we guarantee the fulfillment of any special request.)

[/size][/font][center][img]https://files.catbox.moe/x4nzqr.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/center][font=Georgia][size=3]
Inspired by IRL rugs and geometric patterns/coloring books.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]To my friends in the SDV Discord Modding community: Thanks for all the lovely compliments and support. ✨💜[/size][/font]
